description: This receipt is issued by The Salvation Army Thrift Store and identifies the store as 2659 Alta Vista Drive, Ottawa, Ontario. The header contains the store branding, address, contact telephone number, website, transaction date and time, and cashier identification (Valentina). The receipt records the purchase of a single housewares item. The financial section includes the total purchase amount, a cash-rounding adjustment, the cash tendered, and the change returned. The footer outlines the store's clothing exchange policy and encourages donations of clothing, furniture, and household goods. The overall layout is representative of a Canadian thrift store POS receipt, combining merchandise sales, cash-payment reconciliation, exchange policy information, and charitable messaging within a compact retail receipt format.
